Roster / booking not syncing.label: Client Roster Format & Header Validation
Roster / booking not syncing.description: Verify CSV/API upload conforms to standard RideOps shift roster template (emp_id, shift_code, pickup_lat_lng, nodename).

Roster / booking not syncing.label: Shift Booking Cutoff Verification
Roster / booking not syncing.description: Confirm booking request was submitted prior to client's agreed cutoff window (typically T-120 minutes).

Roster / booking not syncing.label: HRMS / SFTP Sync Connection Check
Roster / booking not syncing.description: Check if client's automated roster sync connector returned 200 OK or authentication failure (expired token).

Roster / booking not syncing.label: Vehicle Route Capacity & Fleet Availability
Roster / booking not syncing.description: Verify unallocated employee had an active route cluster with spare seat capacity.

Live tracking / GPS incorrect.label: Driver App Telematics Ping Recency
Live tracking / GPS incorrect.description: Check telematics telemetry logs: Did driver's device transmit GPS coordinates within the last 60 seconds?

Live tracking / GPS incorrect.label: Device Location Permission & Background State
Live tracking / GPS incorrect.description: Verify driver did not disable high-accuracy GPS or enable OS aggressive battery-saver mode.

Live tracking / GPS incorrect.label: OBD/GPS Hardware Tracker vs Mobile Fallback
Live tracking / GPS incorrect.description: Check whether vehicle has dedicated OBD-II tracker or relies solely on mobile device location.

Live tracking / GPS incorrect.label: Geofence Corridor & Map Provider Status
Live tracking / GPS incorrect.description: Verify if map tiles / route corridor API is experiencing intermittent external latency.

Report export failing.label: Date Range & Data Volume Boundary Check
Report export failing.description: Check if requested export exceeds 90-day synchronous download limit (requires async background queue).

Report export failing.label: User Role & Export Access Permissions
Report export failing.description: Verify client transport admin has 'Billing & Analytics: Export' permission enabled in portal.

Report export failing.label: Filter Criteria & Empty Dataset Check
Report export failing.description: Confirm query filters actually match existing records in selected date range.

OTP / boarding issue.label: SMS Gateway DLR & Carrier Delivery Status
OTP / boarding issue.description: Inspect SMS gateway provider logs for carrier delivery receipt or DND blocking.

OTP / boarding issue.label: Phone Number & Country Code Format Check
OTP / boarding issue.description: Verify employee profile has valid E.164 phone number format without leading zeros.

OTP / boarding issue.label: Driver Manual Boarding Override Token
OTP / boarding issue.description: Verify if supervisor can issue 4-digit emergency boarding bypass code.

Billing / invoice discrepancy.label: Contract Tariff & Rate Card Verification
Billing / invoice discrepancy.description: Match invoice calculation against client's signed rate card (per-km vs flat shift slab).

Billing / invoice discrepancy.label: Toll, Parking & Waiting Time Receipts
Billing / invoice discrepancy.description: Verify attached fastag toll transactions and waiting duration against trip telematics.

Cab delay / no-show complaint.label: Automated Dispatch vs Scheduled Pickup
Cab delay / no-show complaint.description: Audit system dispatch timestamp: was cab dispatched with adequate buffer time?

Cab delay / no-show complaint.label: Driver-to-Employee Contact Logs
Cab delay / no-show complaint.description: Check masked call records to verify driver attempted to contact employee at pickup.

Login / access issue.label: SSO / SAML Identity Provider Status
Login / access issue.description: Verify client Azure AD / Okta SAML certificate validity and user directory sync.

Login / access issue.label: Account Lockout & Password Reset Status
Login / access issue.description: Check if account was locked due to 5 consecutive invalid authentication attempts.

DEFAULT.label: Client Portal Configuration & SLA Tier Verification
DEFAULT.description: Confirm client settings, active contracts, and tier permissions are configured correctly.

DEFAULT.label: Issue Reproduction Attempt
DEFAULT.description: Attempt to reproduce issue in staging/read-only portal using identical parameters.

DEFAULT.label: Error Payloads, Request IDs, or Screenshots
DEFAULT.description: Ensure exact timestamp, affected trip/user ID, and browser/app logs are collected.

DEFAULT.label: Check Known Engineering Issues & Release Notes
DEFAULT.description: Verify this is not already an open engineering ticket or planned maintenance window.
